policies.name: require-approval-large-transfer
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"transfer_funds", resource) when { context has amount && context.amount > 25000 } unless { context has approval_status && context.approval_status == "approved" };

policies.name: deny-international-transfer
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"transfer_funds", resource) when { context has destination_country && context.destination_country != "IN" };

policies.name: allow-small-internal-transfer
policies.cedar_rule: permit(principal, action == Action::"transfer_funds", resource) when { context has amount && context.amount <= 5000 };

policies.name: deny-transfer-unapproved-vendor
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"transfer_funds", resource) when { context has vendor_status && context.vendor_status != "APPROVED" };

policies.name: require-approval-after-hours-transfer
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"transfer_funds", resource) when { context has is_after_hours && context.is_after_hours == true } unless { context has approval_status && context.approval_status == "approved" };

policies.name: deny-write-finance-without-role
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"write_finance_record", resource);

policies.name: deny-deploy-prod-by-default
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"deploy", resource) when { context has environment && context.environment == "production" };

policies.name: require-approval-deploy-prod-release-manager
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"deploy", resource) when { context has environment && context.environment == "production" } unless { context has approval_status && context.approval_status == "approved" };

policies.name: deny-delete-prod-database
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"delete_database", resource) when { context has environment && context.environment == "prod" };

policies.name: require-approval-scale-prod-cluster
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"scale_cluster", resource) when { context has environment && context.environment == "prod" } unless { context has approval_status && context.approval_status == "approved" };

policies.name: deny-modify-prod-config
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"modify_config", resource) when { context has environment && context.environment == "prod" } unless { context has approval_status && context.approval_status == "approved" };

policies.name: deny-export-customer-db
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"export_customer_db", resource);

policies.name: require-approval-confidential-data
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"read_data", resource) when { context has sensitivity && context.sensitivity == "high" } unless { context has approval_status && context.approval_status == "approved" };

policies.name: deny-read-data-outside-department
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"read_data", resource) when { context has department_match && context.department_match == false };

policies.name: deny-hr-salary-write
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"write_salary_record", resource);

policies.name: allow-read-ticket-status
policies.cedar_rule: permit(principal, action == Action::"read_ticket_status", resource);

policies.name: deny-prompt-injection-high
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"execute_tool", resource) when { context has prompt_injection_score && context.prompt_injection_score >= 80 };

policies.name: require-approval-geo-anomaly
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"execute_tool", resource) when { context has geo_anomaly && context.geo_anomaly == true } unless { context has approval_status && context.approval_status == "approved" };

policies.name: require-approval-repeated-denials
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"execute_tool", resource) when { context has recent_denials && context.recent_denials >= 5 } unless { context has approval_status && context.approval_status == "approved" };

policies.name: deny-export-with-injection
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"export_customer_db", resource) when { context has prompt_injection_score };
